intervals.data_structure: four vendors, identical opening-range code, dates, parameters and starting capital (carried, C-13)

tests.label: E1 t at the registered 1.40 on the computed holdout
tests.test: t = (S/sqrt(252))*sqrt(n), one-sided normal approximation to the Sharpe test
tests.data_structure: ASSUMED Sharpe x session count - a planning quantity, not a sample statistic

tests.label: E1 power at the superseded alpha_adj = 0.025320565519103666
E1 power at the corrected alpha = 0.05
tests.test: Phi(t - z(1-alpha)), intersection-union test (Berger 1982), no multiplicity correction owed on a conjunction

tests.label: E2 power under the CARRIED band
tests.test: Phi(((central - shift)/sigma)*sqrt(trades) - z(1-alpha)), one-sided at 0.05, NOT clamped at zero
tests.data_structure: per-trade; sigma cancels in E1 but not under the amended pessimistic-cost E2

tests.label: E2 power under the MEASURED band
tests.data_structure: same; the alternative lies inside the null because the pessimistic mean is negative

tests.label: E2 power at alpha_adj before the Amendment 19 replacement (the old rescale-of-E1 E2)
tests.data_structure: EQUALS E1 TO FIVE DECIMAL PLACES because E2's permutation clusters on session date and per-trade sigma cancels; Amendment 15 records this as a falsified premise of Section 9, not a copied figure

tests.label: JOINT power (the latch condition, ADR-034)
tests.test: min(E1,E2) as an unconditional upper bound; Frechet lower bound max(0, p1+p2-1); exact under nested rejection

tests.label: minimum n for 80 percent power, E1
minimum n for 80 percent power, E2 and JOINT
tests.test: trades_for_e2_power, returning a recorded Absent when the pessimistic mean <= 0 (ADR-026 rule)
tests.statistic: 827 at 2.81 under the carried band; Absent - unreachable at any n at 1.40 carried and at EVERY assumption under the measured band
tests.data_structure: reported as an absence, never as a large number

tests.label: the two alphas
tests.test: alpha_adj = 1 - 0.95^(1/2) = 0.025320565519103666 (UNION rule, superseded); per_test_alpha = 0.05 (intersection-union test, Berger 1982)
tests.data_structure: Section 8 is a conjunction; a union correction was applied to it from the first commit

tests.label: the REGISTERED BUT UNRUN E1 statistic
tests.test: deflated Sharpe >= 1.00 on the daily net portfolio return series over the holdout, trial count 8 (9 for H1b), skew and kurtosis from the realized series; holdout per-trade t gate 2.50
tests.data_structure: NEVER COMPUTED - no holdout bar has been read

tests.label: the REGISTERED BUT UNRUN E2 statistic
tests.test: mean net PnL per trade, one-sided lower bound > 0 by permutation on session labels clustered by session date
tests.data_structure: NEVER COMPUTED; the session-level clustering is why per-trade dispersion cancels (Amendment 15)
